newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Stahl hits new high in Vienna.
newsitem.headline: VA Stahl hits new high in Vienna.

text.p: Shares in steelmaker VA Stahl hit a life-high on the Vienna stock exchange on Monday, buoyed by demand from international investors, and market participants saw potential for further gains before profit-taking set in.
At 1031 GMT, VA Stahl was up 8.4 schillings, or 1.76 percent, up at 486.5 schillings in a generally soft market. Earlier the share touched a high of 495 schillings.
"Some Austrian analysts had started turning negative on VA Stahl at the end of last week but there has been no let-up in demand from international clients," a trader said.
Dealers forecast the 500 schillings level would prove difficult to pierce, however.
"We're in uncharted territory because the stock is at a life-high, but I would certainly expect some profit-taking at 500 schillings," one said. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
